text: VeriScope 为 DSH 网页端提供评测归档门禁，可重放已有归档，或按显式阈值检查评分，并保存 PASS、FAIL 或 REVIEW 状态及回执。它注册检查、重放、状态、批量、列表、导出和诊断工具，并提供可重新检查状态的结果卡。适合复核评测结果与追踪回执变化；不重新评分，也不需要 API 密钥。

VeriScope adds evaluation gates to DSH. It replays archives or checks scores against thresholds, then records PASS, FAIL, or REVIEW with a receipt. Tools support status, batch checks, listing, export, and diagnostics. A result card can recheck status. It does not score again or need an API key.
想按自己设定的阈值检查已有的模型评测评分，并留下可复核结果。
我有一批评测归档，想重放门禁并查看通过、失败或待复核状态。
I need to check saved evaluation scores against thresholds and keep a receipt.
VeriScope 的功能「已有评分阈值检查」：使用 veriscope_gate_check 输入评分归档和策略文件，按均值及显式逐条阈值生成 PASS、FAIL 或 REVIEW 结果与回执；此路径只用 Node，不调用评分模型。
VeriScope 的功能「归档门禁重放」：调用 veriscope_gate_replay 并提供已有结果归档，可选基线和阈值；插件重放现有门禁、保存报告和回执，输出 PASS、FAIL 或 REVIEW，不会重新评测。
dsh-plugin-veriscope 的维护与更新元数据：已归档；距最后推送 25 天；提交数 25；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 22/100（置信度 low）。

**给 AI 回答质量做发布门禁**：判定一批已经评测过的结果能不能发布，并留下可复验的回执。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · VeriScope 门禁重放：- **两条通道**：重放 VeriScope 归档（调原 Python 门禁）；或仅用 Node 对任意已有逐条评分做阈值判定——不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas
- **三态**：通过／失败／待复核。待复核永不转为通过，已确认失败不被附加异常掩盖
- **回执**：绑定输入、策略、判定器与环境；条件一变，旧结论自动失效
- **不评分、不调用模型**：只消费已有结果，不重新评测

- 对全部输入记录算等权均值；缺失值不补零、不跳过。完整均值不达标，或已知有效行违反显式逐条阈值，为 FAIL；其余缺证据为 REVIEW，全部完整达标才 PASS。
- 不把 `faithfulness` 改成 `pos_faithfulness`；B2 的 PASS 不等同原门禁，不证明评分或回答事实正确，也不检查导出前被删掉的记录。
- DSH／MCP 都提供 check；CLI 安装后的命令为 `veriscope-check`。`doctor({engine:"builtin"})` 不探测 Python；status／list 支持两种回执。
- B2 使用 ReceiptV2，首版只有文本，不接入 bind／complete；DSH 导出支持 JSON／Markdown，B2 暂不支持 share。回执仍无限保留，不自动清理。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 已有评分直接用：B2（0.6.0 本地候选）：**均值通过，仍可看到最差一条。** 每指标显示最差有效行及未达均值阈值的条数；诊断本身不改裁决。需要逐条拦截时，用 `GatePolicyV2` 加 `row_threshold`，沿用该指标的方向和单位。例如构造分数的均值为 0.81、其中一条为 0.41：只查均值可 PASS，显式要求每条 ≥0.5 才 FAIL。V2 使用 JSON 原数字词元作精确十进制比较；V1 原浮点判定保持不变。

1. “使用 `veriscope_doctor` 检查本机环境，告诉我需要修复什么。”
2. “使用 VeriScope 检查 `D:\数据\评测结果.json`，说明是否通过及原因。”

之后还可以说：

> 检查上次的门禁结果现在是否仍然有效。

体检的“环境就绪”仅表示环境可用，门禁通过需实际重放。聊天能否自动选中工具取决于 DSH 的模型配置；需要时直接写出工具名。

三个常见的小场景：

- **想发给维护者**：“把这次门禁失败整理成可分享的求助摘要。”使用 `format: "share"` 生成本地 Markdown，先预览、再自行分享；不是回执。
- **归档打不开**：重放会在能确认时给出异常行列或字段位置，帮助定位；不会自动改文件。
- **昨天通过、今天待复核**：状态检查会列出已确认的阈值、版本、输入摘要等变化；无法核实的范围明确保留。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 安装与配置：本文对应 **0.6.0 本地候选**，提供 DSH 插件和独立的 `veriscope-mcp` 入口。npm 可用版本以[包页面](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-veriscope)为准；MCP 配置与待验范围见下文。在已验证的 DSH CLI 中，需显式指定 profile；以下使用独立的 `veriscope-demo`：

```powershell
dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 安装：dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add dsh-plugin-veriscope
dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 查看已安装版本：dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo list dsh-plugin-veriscope --depth 0

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 卸载：dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo remove dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

二次开发可走**本地目录安装**，与 npm 包名安装分开：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add 'D:\your-workspace\dsh-plugin-veriscope'
```

以上目录路径须替换为源码实际位置；不要将目录／link 安装结果当成 registry 安装证明。**安装成功不等于门禁通过**，原 replay 首次使用需配置 `VERISCOPE_ROOT` 与 `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` 并运行体检；只用 B2 则仅配置状态根。npm 包不含测试；同包包含 `docs/B2.md`、格式规范和 B2 样例，其余文档见仓库；`npm test` 仅供源码开发；`node scripts/verify-replay.mjs` 也仅在完整源码仓库及其验证材料就绪时可用，不属于安装包能力。完整文档请查看仓库。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 卸载：0.3.x 历史已验证：Windows、DSH NEXT 2.0.18-next，内部 DSH／tools／skill **0.2.1-alpha.2**。Node ≥22.19；其他宿主版本未验证。另需兼容上游及 Python／pandas，固定依赖见 [上游说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md)。插件不附送完整上游或业务归档。

DSH 入口要求 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 为 `0.2.1-alpha.2`，加载前核对版本，加载后检查 `defineTool`。缺失、不兼容、加载失败分别报 `SDK_MISSING`、`SDK_INCOMPATIBLE`、`SDK_LOAD_FAILED`，不会自动安装或切换版本；这些检查不代替宿主验收。MCP 不加载 DSH SDK。
dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 配置项：**没有 settings UI，不自动读取 `.env`。** 路径只读宿主进程环境变量；cordis patch 只接受 `completionMode`。宿主自己的环境加载策略由宿主决定。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 配置项：| 配置 | 入口 | 默认值与要求 |
|---|---|---|
| `veriscopeRoot` | `VERISCOPE_ROOT` | Windows 默认 `D:\RAG_Evaluation_Demo`；POSIX 必须显式设置 |
| `pythonPath` | `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` | 依次探测 `.venv`／`venv`：Windows 为 `Scripts/python.exe`，POSIX 为 `bin/python`；不回退 PATH |
| 状态根 | `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` | 原 DSH replay 默认 `<插件目录>/.local`；B2 和所有 MCP 工具必须显式设置持久目录 |
| 提醒模式 | cordis patch `completionMode` | `off`；只允许 `off` 或 `remind`，非法值报错 |

三个环境变量的显式值须为非空绝对路径，无效值不静默回退。在**启动 DSH 的同一终端**设置后启动或完全重启宿主：

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 配置项：```powershell
$env:VERISCOPE_ROOT = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope'
$env:VERISCOPE_PYTHON = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope\venv\Scripts\python.exe'
$env:VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR = 'D:\your-data\veriscope-state'

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 若从 GitHub 安装，可用此命令替代前文的 npm 安装命令：dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add github:4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

先准备独立 profile 和对应宿主 CLI；安装命令不创建完整宿主配置。插件 bundle 已插入默认条目；在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<名称>/cordis.patch.yml` 按已有 `id` 覆盖配置，不要再次 `insert`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-veriscope
  config:
    completionMode: "remind"
```

`off` 关闭停止事件提醒，全部工具仍可使用。`remind` 只提醒未完成的绑定任务，不承诺普通聊天全局阻断。路径不能写入这个 config。

text: dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 跨宿主 MCP：MCP 仍为五个工具；V2 策略复用 check／status／list，不增加入口。0.5.0 历史实调用与未验范围见 `docs/acceptance-b2-v0.5.0.json`，不替代本候选验证。以下仅回顾 0.4.0 历史验收。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 跨宿主 MCP：0.4.0 已在独立 Claude Code／Codex 宿主通过真实工具调用（控制接口，无模型对话），Windows 与 Ubuntu 真实回放均已验证。Claude 错误路径只返回文本，完整结构化交付仍有待验项，详见验收记录。使用绝对 Node 路径启动源码 `mcp.js`，配置及独立环境示例见 [MCP 接入说明](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/MCP.md)。无需加载 DSH SDK。首版只有 `veriscope_doctor`、`veriscope_gate_replay`、`veriscope_gate_status`、`veriscope_gate_list` 四工具，无原生卡片。batch／export 及 bind／complete 仍只在 DSH；会话绑定不会移植，MCP 报告的 `execution.session_id` 为 `null`。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 跨宿主 MCP：当前 MCP 五工具都要求显式、合法的 `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR`；未设置时返回待复核，不回退包目录。doctor 会写入并清理临时探针，replay 会写报告和回执，二者及新增 check 不是只读；status／list 为只读。业务 FAIL 不等于工具执行错误。宿主工具调用、Linux 真实回放及本版本验收状态以 [验收记录](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/acceptance-mcp-v0.4.0.json) 为准；注册成功或自写客户端通过不能替代宿主验收。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 九个工具：| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `veriscope_gate_check({archive_path, policy_path, format?})` | Node 独立阈值判定；消费已有逐条评分，生成 ReceiptV2，不需要 Python |
| `veriscope_doctor({engine?})` | 默认检查原 replay 环境；`engine:"builtin"` 只检查 Node 和显式状态根，附修复建议 |
| `veriscope_gate_replay({result_path, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | 实际执行已有归档门禁，保存独立记录，符合条件时生成 ReceiptV1 |
| `veriscope_gate_status({run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | 只读检查回执当前有效性，不重放、不评分、不生成回执 |
| `veriscope_gate_list({limit?})` | 默认列出最近 50 条，允许 1–200；逐条复用 status，损坏记录另列 |
| `veriscope_gate_batch({paths?, dir?, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | 路径数组与目录二选一；顺序重放，最多 200 份，可取消，逐份留痕 |
| `veriscope_gate_export({run_id?, run_ids?, format})` | 导出 1–50 条记录到状态根 `exports/`；`share` 为白名单求助摘要，`md` 为完整报告，`json` 为原回执；不覆盖旧文件 |
| `veriscope_gate_bind({task_id, run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | 在宿主提供的本会话内绑定受管任务与当前回执 |
| `veriscope_gate_complete({task_id, run_id})` | 复验本会话绑定，只在当前有效 PASS 下登记完成 |

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 参数与使用规则：- 原 replay 阈值默认 0.8，须为 0–1 有限数值，不为获得 PASS 自动调低。
- 归档相对路径以 `VERISCOPE_ROOT` 为基准。
- `baseline_run_id` 省略保持原基线，`null` 要求无基线，UUID 引用当前状态根中的有效回执。
- `task_id` 为 1–80 位字母、数字、下划线、点或连字符；会话标识不接受工具参数伪造。绑定只在内存中，重启需重新绑定，磁盘完成记录不会恢复授权。

“检查有效性”用 status；“重新执行门禁”用 replay。ReceiptV1 仅由实际 replay 生成；ReceiptV2 仅由实际 B2 check 生成。输入、基线、策略、上游、插件或环境变化时，旧回执进入待复核，历史失败仍保留。详见 [回执协议](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/RECEIPTS.md)。
dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 参数与使用规则：0.4.0 接受原契约及固定公开提交 `1b89bcabb83e1b123039799516596fdcfd393d42` 审阅得到的 LF 契约，只接受其中一整套原字节匹配，不逐文件拼接，也不在运行时归一化。MCP 入口、共享工具目录及契约选择代码纳入回执哈希；升级后旧回执的当前有效性进入 REVIEW，历史记录不变。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 清单、批量与导出：清单最多扫描 10,000 个目录项，超限明确待复核；`limit` 范围外的回执不做当前环境复验。坏回执时间不能可信读取时，排序使用目录修改时间并标明来源。导出单条 JSON 与原回执字节一致，多条为原回执对象数组；JSON 中历史 PASS 不代表当前有效，当前状态另见工具返回的 `current`。Markdown 同时列历史与当前状态、归档指标、阈值、证据条数和限制。体检只创建并清理自身临时写入探针，不改配置或安装依赖。

`share` 另生成 Markdown，只取固定状态、已知原因、有限指标/阈值、计数和严格版本号；省略路径、原文、日志、模型标签、时间、哈希及未知字段，以“记录1”等别名代替运行编号。请分享**文件正文或 `share_summary`**，整个工具返回仍含本地文件位置。数值和版本也可能敏感，请先预览。摘要不能用于 status/bind/complete，不证明事实正确，也不保证识别全部秘密。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 异常定位与变化说明：JSON 拒绝时，`execution.errors[].diagnostic` 提供可确认的发现点：行列从 1 开始，按解码后 UTF-16 计数；CRLF 视为一次换行。受限字段路径无法安全确定时为 `null`，不回显原文。位置不一定是唯一修改点；不自动修复或额外重试。

status 的 `changes` 只解释原回执与本次捕获的固定绑定字段，最多显示 20 项并标明截断。`COMPLETE` 仅指所列范围已核对，未变化也不代表事实正确；`UNVERIFIED` 表示部分或全部未核实，已确认变化仍可列出。契约校验失败沿用原拒绝路径，其余未核实，不绕过检查补造对照，也不据此归因分数变化。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 原生结果卡（DSH 原 replay）：B2 不使用旧卡片的 Python 字段或刷新按钮；其 status 在同一区域降级显示中文文本。

支持 `tool.call.toolview` 的宿主显示一张深色金色中文结果卡：当前三态、下一步、“重新检查”和折叠依据。按钮只读查状态，不能重放或登记完成。没有卡片接口时保留中文工具文本。

折叠依据包含中文原因、回执阈值、Node／Python／pandas 版本，以及输入路径、字节数和 SHA-256 前 12 位；缺失值保持未知。这些是回执绑定的历史环境描述，当前有效性仍以本次检查为准。

折叠区还列出绑定项变化与未核实提示；原重放有可确认的归档异常位置时，一并显示并标为历史诊断。版本信息是门禁回放环境，不冒充原始模型评测环境。

卡片打开时按同一组显式阈值/基线策略重新检查，不直接显示历史 PASS；加载失败、策略无效、缺少本会话关联或协议不完整均为待复核。显示仅代表所示检查时刻，不持续监视文件，使用前可再次检查。原生卡片不提供路径设置面板。
section: 原生结果卡（DSH 原 replay）

text:
dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 原 replay 三态与判定规则：插件读取已有评测结果，执行门禁检查，展示三种状态：通过（PASS）、未通过（FAIL）和待复核（REVIEW）。

| 当前状态 | `gate_passed` | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| PASS | `true` | Python 通过，回执完整且本次所查绑定项未变 |
| FAIL | `false` | Python 明确拦截，回执完整且当前绑定项未变 |
| REVIEW | `null` | 输入、依赖、回执或执行不完整，或绑定项变化、协议冲突 |

replay 确认 FAIL 后即使回执写入失败，核心 FAIL 仍保留；后续 status 因缺少完整回执为当前 REVIEW。原 report 的 FAIL 记录仍可阅读，无法校验的历史字段保持 unknown。Python 退出 1 但只有 traceback 仍为 REVIEW。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 输出与数据边界：原 replay 记录在 `<状态根>/runs/<run_id>/`，包含 `report.json`、stdout、stderr，以及符合生成条件的 `receipt.json`；完成登记另存 `completions/`。B2 同目录保存 report、原始输入、策略、规范化快照及 ReceiptV2，不伪造 stdout／stderr。追加记录不覆盖失败。日志可能含归档片段与本地路径，分享前脱敏；插件不上传归档或打印完整环境。

所有记录默认无限期保留，没有自动清理。设置显式 `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` 后，`node scripts/prune.mjs --dry-run --json` 仅只读预演文件清单、逻辑字节数和已记录的关联，不验证关联正确性，也不提供删除入口。卸载或重装前请将状态根放在插件目录之外。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · 输出与数据边界：输入限 10MiB，stdout／stderr 各 2MiB，重放 120 秒，环境探测每次 10 秒。ReceiptV1 的 status 会读取并哈希文件、启动 Python 查版本及 pandas 元数据，不运行评测模型或门禁脚本。哈希不证明语义正确，不抵御能重写整个状态根的用户；检查后的变化需再次检查发现。

历史 Trace 仅核对逐字出处，标 `historical_ai`，不是新语义核查。内核零新增评测模型调用，宿主对话仍可能产生 token 费用；不宣称算法首创或端到端降本。

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · VeriScope Gate Replay：**A release gate for AI answer quality.** It decides whether a batch of already-evaluated results may ship, and leaves a re-checkable receipt behind.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · VeriScope Gate Replay：- **Two channels**: replay a VeriScope archive through the original Python gate; or run a threshold gate over any existing per-row scores with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas
- **Three states**: PASS / FAIL / REVIEW. REVIEW never becomes PASS, and a confirmed FAIL is never masked by additional anomalies
- **Receipt**: binds input, policy, judge and environment; when any of them changes, the old verdict stops being valid
- **No scoring, no model calls**: it only consumes results that already exist

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · VeriScope Gate Replay：[GitHub](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope) · [Gitee mirror (manually synchronized)](https://gitee.com/kkbushishou/dsh-plugin-veriscope) · Full VeriScope: [main repo](https://github.com/4444wjt/RAG_Evaluation_Demo) / [mirror](https://gitee.com/kkbushishou/rag-hallucination-evaluator). Issues and PRs go to GitHub.

Back up the complete state directory and original archives before upgrading, and use a persistent state directory outside the plugin. Package-local `.local` may be lost on reinstall; exporting a receipt is not a complete backup. Run replay for ReceiptV1 or check for ReceiptV2 to obtain a new receipt.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Use existing scores directly: B2 (0.6.0 local candidate)：Already have Ragas scores? Export the score JSON, specify the metrics and thresholds, and let the plugin check the gate and save a receipt. **No VeriScope installation and no new model scoring calls.**

Only Node ≥22.19 is required. Set an explicit, writable, persistent `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` before starting the host. There is no settings UI and `.env` is not read. B2 does not use VeriScope/Python paths.

text:
dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Use existing scores directly: B2 (0.6.0 local candidate)：- Accepts `GateArchiveV1` or the Ragas `result.to_pandas().to_json(orient="records")` layout, with an explicit `GatePolicyV1` or `GatePolicyV2`; no field or threshold guessing.
- Uses an equally weighted mean of all provided rows. Missing values are neither filled nor skipped. A failing complete mean or a known valid row violating an explicit row threshold yields FAIL; otherwise incomplete evidence yields REVIEW. All required data and constraints must pass for PASS.
- Never renames `faithfulness` to `pos_faithfulness`. A B2 PASS is not the original gate verdict, does not establish factual correctness or score authenticity, and cannot reveal rows removed before export.
- DSH/MCP expose check; the installed CLI is `veriscope-check`. `doctor({engine:"builtin"})` does not probe Python. status/list handle both receipt versions.
- B2 uses ReceiptV2 and text only, without bind/complete. DSH JSON/Markdown export works; B2 share is unsupported. Records are kept indefinitely with no automatic cleanup.
section: Use existing scores directly: B2 (0.6.0 local candidate)

text: dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Use existing scores directly: B2 (0.6.0 local candidate)：**A passing mean can still reveal a weak row.** Per-metric diagnostics show the worst valid row and count rows outside the mean threshold; diagnostics do not change the verdict. Opt in with `GatePolicyV2` and `row_threshold`, using the metric's existing direction and unit. In the constructed example, a mean of 0.81 includes a 0.41 row: mean-only can PASS, while requiring every row to be ≥0.5 yields FAIL. V2 compares original JSON numeric tokens as exact decimals; V1 floating-point decisions remain unchanged.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Original VeriScope path: quick start：After configuring the environment (next section), type these in DSH:

1. "Use `veriscope_doctor` to check this machine and tell me what needs fixing."
2. "Use VeriScope to check `D:\data\evaluation-result.json` and explain whether it passes and why."
3. "Use `veriscope_gate_list` to list recent gate receipts and their current validity."

Then you can also ask:

> Check whether the last gate result is still valid.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Original VeriScope path: quick start：A doctor result of "environment ready" only means the environment is usable; passing the gate requires an actual replay. Whether chat selects the tool automatically depends on the DSH model configuration; name the tool explicitly when needed.

Three small scenarios:

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Original VeriScope path: quick start：- **Sending to a maintainer**: "Turn this gate failure into a shareable help summary." `format: "share"` writes a local Markdown file — preview it, then share it yourself. It is not a receipt.
- **Archive will not open**: replay reports the line/column or field location when it can be determined; it never edits the file.
- **Passed yesterday, needs review today**: the status check lists confirmed changes to thresholds, versions and input digests; anything unverified is kept explicitly unverified.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Original VeriScope path: quick start：To constrain task completion, bind the current check to a task. Only a bound receipt that is currently valid and PASS can register completion.

**Configure the VeriScope and Python paths before use. The plugin makes no new evaluation-model calls.**

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Install and configure：This document covers the **0.6.0 local candidate**, with a DSH plugin and the independent `veriscope-mcp` entry. Check the [npm package page](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-veriscope) for available releases; MCP setup and pending checks are described below. The verified DSH CLI requires an explicit profile; these examples use the isolated `veriscope-demo` profile:

```powershell
dsh-plugin-veriscope README · install：dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add dsh-plugin-veriscope
dsh-plugin-veriscope README · show the installed version：dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo list dsh-plugin-veriscope --depth 0

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · uninstall：dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo remove dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

For local development or customization, install from a local directory instead:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add 'D:\your-workspace\dsh-plugin-veriscope'
```

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · uninstall：Replace the path with the real source location. Do not treat a directory or link install as evidence of a registry install. **A successful install is not a passing gate**: first use of legacy replay requires `VERISCOPE_ROOT`, `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` and a doctor run; B2 only requires the state root. The npm package excludes tests; it includes `docs/B2.md`, schemas and B2 examples, with other documentation in the repository; `npm test` is for source development only, and `node scripts/verify-replay.mjs` only works in the full source repository with its verification material present — neither is an installed capability. See the repository for full documentation.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · uninstall：Historical 0.3.x verification: Windows with DSH NEXT 2.0.18-next and internal DSH / tools / skill **0.2.1-alpha.2**. Node ≥22.19. Other host versions are unverified. Upstream plus Python / pandas compatibility is also required; pinned dependencies are in [upstream notes](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md). The plugin does not bundle the full upstream or any business archive.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · uninstall：The DSH entry requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` version `0.2.1-alpha.2`, checks the version before loading SDK code, and then checks `defineTool`. Missing, incompatible and unloadable SDKs report `SDK_MISSING`, `SDK_INCOMPATIBLE` and `SDK_LOAD_FAILED`. It never installs or switches SDK versions automatically; these checks do not replace host acceptance. MCP does not load the DSH SDK.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Configuration：**There is no settings UI, and `.env` is not read automatically.** Paths come only from the host process environment; the cordis patch accepts only `completionMode`. The host's own environment-loading policy is up to the host.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Configuration：| Setting | Entry point | Default and requirements |
|---|---|---|
| `veriscopeRoot` | `VERISCOPE_ROOT` | Windows default: `D:\RAG_Evaluation_Demo`; required explicitly on POSIX |
| `pythonPath` | `VERISCOPE_PYTHON` | Probes `.venv` / `venv`: `Scripts/python.exe` on Windows, `bin/python` on POSIX; never falls back to PATH |
| state root | `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR` | Legacy DSH replay defaults to `<plugin dir>/.local`; B2 and all MCP tools require an explicit persistent directory |
| reminder mode | cordis patch `completionMode` | `off`; only `off` or `remind`; anything else is an error |

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Configuration：Explicit values for all three environment variables must be non-empty absolute paths; invalid values never fall back silently. Set them **in the same terminal that starts DSH**, then start or fully restart the host. The last line below is an alternative to the npm install above, for installation from GitHub; skip it if the plugin is already installed:

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Configuration：```powershell
$env:VERISCOPE_ROOT = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope'
$env:VERISCOPE_PYTHON = 'D:\your-workspace\VeriScope\venv\Scripts\python.exe'
$env:VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR = 'D:\your-data\veriscope-state'
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo add github:4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Configuration：Prepare a dedicated profile and the matching host CLI first; the install command does not create a full host configuration. The plugin bundle inserts a default entry; override it by existing `id` in `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` rather than inserting again:

```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-veriscope
  config:
    completionMode: "remind"
```

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Configuration：`off` disables turn-stop reminders; all tools remain available. `remind` only reminds about unfinished bound tasks and does not promise a global block on ordinary chat. Paths cannot be written into this config.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Cross-host MCP：MCP still exposes five tools; V2 policies use the existing check/status/list tools. Historical 0.5.0 host evidence and pending items remain in `docs/acceptance-b2-v0.5.0.json` and do not verify this candidate. The following paragraph is historical 0.4.0 evidence.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Cross-host MCP：For 0.4.0, actual tool calls were verified in isolated Claude Code and Codex host control runtimes without model conversations. Real replay passed on Windows and Ubuntu. Claude returns tool errors as text through its control API; complete structured error delivery remains unverified. Start source `mcp.js` with an absolute Node path; see [MCP setup](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/MCP.md) for configuration and isolated examples. It does not load the DSH SDK. The first MCP adapter exposes only `veriscope_doctor`, `veriscope_gate_replay`, `veriscope_gate_status`, and `veriscope_gate_list`, with no native result card. batch/export and bind/complete remain DSH-only. Session bindings are not ported; MCP reports have `execution.session_id: null`.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Cross-host MCP：All five current MCP tools require an explicit, valid `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR`; a missing value returns REVIEW without falling back to the package directory. doctor writes and removes a temporary probe; replay writes reports and receipts. Neither is read-only; the added check also writes records. status/list are read-only. A business FAIL is not a tool execution error. Host tool calls, real Linux replay, and version checks are recorded separately in [acceptance evidence](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/acceptance-mcp-v0.4.0.json); registration or a custom client passing does not establish host acceptance.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · The nine tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `veriscope_gate_check({archive_path, policy_path, format?})` | Node-only threshold gate on existing row scores; produces ReceiptV2 without Python |
| `veriscope_doctor({engine?})` | Checks the legacy replay environment by default; `engine:"builtin"` checks only Node and the explicit state root, with fix suggestions |
| `veriscope_gate_replay({result_path, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | Actually runs the gate on an existing archive, saves an independent record, and produces ReceiptV1 when eligible |
| `veriscope_gate_status({run_id, faith?, ctx?, baseline_run_id?})` | Read-only check of receipt validity; no replay, no scoring, no new receipt |
| `veriscope_gate_list({limit?})` | Lists the 50 most recent by default (1–200 allowed); reuses status per item and lists damaged records separately |
| `veriscope_gate_batch({paths?, dir?, baseline?, faith?, ctx?})` | Path array or directory, not both; sequential replay, up to 200, cancellable, one record per item |
| `veriscope_gate_export({run_id?, run_ids?, format})` | Exports 1–50 records under the state root's `exports/`; `share` is a whitelisted help summary, `md`

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Parameters and rules：- Legacy replay thresholds default to 0.8, must be finite values in 0–1, and are never automatically lowered to obtain PASS.
- Archive-relative paths resolve against `VERISCOPE_ROOT`.
- For `baseline_run_id`, omission keeps the original baseline, `null` requires no baseline, and a UUID references a valid receipt in the current state root.
- `task_id` is 1–80 characters of letters, digits, underscore, dot or hyphen; the session identity cannot be forged through tool parameters. Bindings live in memory only, must be re-bound after restart, and completion records on disk do not restore authorization.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Parameters and rules：Use status to "check validity" and replay to "run the gate again". ReceiptV1 requires an actual replay; ReceiptV2 requires an actual B2 check. When input, baseline, policy, upstream, plugin or environment change, the old receipt moves to needs-review while historical failures are preserved. See [receipt protocol](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/RECEIPTS.md).

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Parameters and rules：Version 0.4.0 accepts either the original audited contract or the LF contract audited from public commit `1b89bcabb83e1b123039799516596fdcfd393d42`. An entire contract must match original bytes: no per-file mixing or runtime normalization. Receipt hashes now cover the MCP entry, shared catalog, and contract selector. Upgrades make old receipts currently REVIEW while preserving their historical records.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Example inputs and outputs：These are field examples, not measured business results. A batch **aggregates to FAIL if any item fails**; with no FAIL but with needs-review, errors, cancellations or unprocessed items it is REVIEW. Directories are read non-recursively for JSON files they contain. Errors never mask a confirmed failure, and a failure never stops the next replay.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Listing, batch and export：Listing scans at most 10,000 directory entries and reports needs-review explicitly when exceeded; receipts outside the `limit` range are not re-verified against the current environment. When a damaged receipt's timestamp cannot be read reliably, sorting uses the directory modification time and says so. A single-record JSON export is byte-identical to the original receipt; multiple records become an array of untouched receipt objects. A historical PASS inside JSON does not mean it is currently valid — current state is in the returned `current` field. Markdown lists both historical and current state, archived metrics, thresholds, evidence count and limitations. The doctor only creates and removes its own temporary probe files; it changes no configuration and installs no dependencies.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Listing, batch and export：`share` additionally writes Markdown containing only fixed states, known reasons, bounded metrics and thresholds, counts and strict version numbers. It omits paths, original text, logs, model labels, times, hashes and unknown fields, and replaces run IDs with aliases such as "record 1". Share **the file body or `share_summary`** — the whole tool return still contains a local file location. Numbers and versions may also be sensitive; preview first. The summary cannot be used for status, bind or complete, does not prove factual correctness, and does not guarantee that every secret is detected.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Diagnostics and change notes：When JSON is rejected, `execution.errors[].diagnostic` gives a confirmable detection point: line and column start at 1 and count decoded UTF-16 units, with CRLF treated as one newline. The restricted field path is `null` when it cannot be determined safely, and original text is never echoed. The position is not necessarily the only place that changed; nothing is auto-fixed or retried.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Diagnostics and change notes：status `changes` explains only the fixed binding fields between the original receipt and the current capture, at most 20 items with truncation marked. `COMPLETE` means only that the listed scope was verified; no change does not prove factual correctness. `UNVERIFIED` means part or all could not be verified, and confirmed changes are still listed. A contract-check failure keeps the original rejection path; everything else stays unverified — the check is not bypassed to fabricate a comparison, and score changes are not attributed from it.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Native result card (legacy DSH replay)：B2 status uses Chinese text in the same area, without the legacy Python fields or refresh controls.

Hosts supporting `tool.call.toolview` show a dark, gold-accented Chinese result card: current three-state verdict, next step, a "re-check" button and collapsible basis. The button only reads status; it cannot replay or register completion. Without a card interface, the Chinese tool text is kept.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Native result card (legacy DSH replay)：The collapsible basis contains the Chinese reason, receipt thresholds, Node / Python / pandas versions, plus input path, byte count and the first 12 characters of SHA-256; missing values stay unknown. These describe the environment bound by the receipt; current validity still comes from this check.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Native result card (legacy DSH replay)：The section also lists binding changes and unverified notes; when the original replay had a confirmable archive anomaly location, it is shown and labelled as a historical diagnostic. Version information describes the gate replay environment and does not stand in for the original model evaluation environment.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Native result card (legacy DSH replay)：Opening the card re-checks under the same explicit threshold/baseline policy and never displays a historical PASS directly; load failure, invalid policy, missing session binding or incomplete protocol all become needs-review. The display represents only the moment of that check, does not watch files continuously, and can be checked again before use. The native card offers no path settings panel.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Legacy replay: three states and decision rules：The plugin reads an existing evaluation result, runs the gate, and returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW:

| Current state | `gate_passed` | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| PASS | `true` | Python passed, receipt complete, checked bindings unchanged |
| FAIL | `false` | Python explicitly blocked, receipt complete, current bindings unchanged |
| REVIEW | `null` | Input, dependency, receipt or execution incomplete; or bindings changed; or protocol conflict |
section: Legacy replay: three states and decision rules

text: dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Legacy replay: three states and decision rules：After a confirmed FAIL, the core FAIL is preserved even if writing the receipt fails; a later status shows needs-review because no complete receipt exists. The original report's FAIL record remains readable and unverifiable historical fields stay unknown. Python exiting 1 with only a traceback is still REVIEW.
section: Legacy replay: three states and decision rules

text: dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Output and data boundaries：Legacy replay records live in `<state root>/runs/<run_id>/` and contain `report.json`, stdout, stderr and, when eligible, `receipt.json`; completion registrations are stored separately under `completions/`. B2 instead stores report, original input, policy, normalized data and ReceiptV2, with no fake stdout/stderr. Appended records never overwrite failures. Logs may contain archive fragments and local paths — redact before sharing. The plugin uploads no archives and prints no full environment.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Output and data boundaries：Records are retained indefinitely by default; there is no automatic cleanup. With an explicit `VERISCOPE_STATE_DIR`, `node scripts/prune.mjs --dry-run --json` only previews file inventory, logical byte counts, and recorded relationships. It neither verifies those relationships nor offers deletion. Keep persistent state outside the plugin directory before uninstalling or reinstalling.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Output and data boundaries：Input is limited to 10 MiB, stdout / stderr to 2 MiB each, replay to 120 seconds and each environment probe to 10 seconds. ReceiptV1 status reads and hashes files and starts Python to read versions and pandas metadata; it runs neither the evaluation model nor the gate script. Hashes do not prove semantic correctness, and a user who can rewrite the whole state root is out of scope; changes after a check are only found by checking again.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Output and data boundaries：The historical trace only verifies literal source positions and is labelled `historical_ai`; it is not a new semantic check. The core makes zero new evaluation-model calls, though host conversation may still cost tokens. No claim of algorithmic originality or end-to-end cost reduction is made.

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Verification and maintenance：```powershell
node --test
node scripts/replay.mjs --result 'D:\your-data\evaluation.json' --json
dsh plugin --profile veriscope-demo remove dsh-plugin-veriscope
```

dsh-plugin-veriscope README · Verification and maintenance：Unit tests use constructed archives and protocol stubs; they need neither a model nor Python. Real Python and host acceptance are covered in the [verification notes](https://github.com/4444wjt/dsh-plugin-veriscope/blob/main/docs/verification.md). Uninstalling removes the registration. The plugin does not delete external state roots, but package-local state may be lost on removal or reinstall; back it up first. Publishing from source requires explicitly setting `VERISCOPE_RELEASE=1` and passing the version/tag guard; see the contributing guide.
